title: Publisher Result
description: DC-003-I025 — the authoritative local record of one successful publication. Written after a Publisher Adapter (google-drive-publisher-adapter.mjs is the first and, as of I025, only implementation) completes an upload — never before, never for a failed attempt. Deliberately provider-neutral: `provider`/`destination`/`provider_reference`/`metadata` carry whatever a given publisher's own result shape produces, so a future non-Drive publisher (out of scope for I025 itself) can populate this same schema without a schema change. The publisher performs work; this object records the outcome — it is the source of truth for "has this been published," the publisher itself is not.

provider.description: e.g. "google-drive" — the publisher adapter's own `.name`/result `publisher` field, passed through verbatim, never re-derived.

destination.description: A human-navigable location for the published package, e.g. a Drive folder URL.

status.description: This schema represents one successful publication only — a failed publish attempt never produces a Publisher Result (out of scope: retries/queueing/failure-tracking belong to a future publisher-analytics milestone).

provider_reference.description: An opaque provider-specific identifier for the published location, e.g. a Drive folder ID — never a credential or access token.

metadata.description: Provider-specific extra evidence that doesn't fit the fields above (e.g. Google Drive's own files-uploaded count). Deliberately not `additionalProperties: false` — unlike every other schema in this repository — since its whole purpose is to vary by publisher without requiring a schema change; still always present, `{}` when a provider has nothing extra to add, never omitted.
